rationale: BLOCKED. I read the complete held EO 12602 (52 FR 27187, July 15, 1987): a single sentence amending sec. 2(b) of EO 12493 of Dec. 5, 1984, 'as amended', by replacing '90 days' with '365 days' (the rest of the held extract is unrelated FAA special conditions from neighbouring pages). It is a pure amendment with no own term and no savings clause; its effect exists only as text of EO 12493 sec. 2(b). The history has the catalog note 'Amends: EO 12493' and a 1989 Codification row classified 'effect_merged_into_other_document' ('Amends EO 12493'), which tells me the 1989 editors folded it into the base order but nothing about an ending. Whether it is still operative depends entirely on whether EO 12493 (the President's Commission on Executive Exchange) remains in force or was revoked, and I hold neither that order's text nor any later instrument. I decline to infer a status from the identity of the base order alone.
